initial_prompt: Write a short poem about a robot discovering a flower for the first time. Use a melancholic but hopeful tone.

messages.content: Write a short poem about a robot discovering a flower for the first time. Use a melancholic but hopeful tone.

The world is built of ash and steel,
Where nothing breathes and nothing feels.
My optic lens, a hollow glass,
Records the shadows as they pass.

But there, beneath a heavy stone,
A single spark of life is sown.
A violet head, too soft to last,
Against the winter's biting blast.

I calculate its wilting date,
A fragile thing, a fleeting fate.
Yet I extend a rusted palm
To shield it from the coming storm.

I cannot know the sun or rain,
I cannot share its quiet pain.
But in this graveyard, vast and deep,
I found a promise I will keep.
